title: Plugin metrics line
description: One line of a plugin metrics event stream or run summary, format version 1. The envelope keys come first, in the order of required, and the plugin's own fields follow.

ts.description: When the line was written, in UTC.

plugin.description: The plugin that wrote the line.

plugin_version.description: The writing plugin's version, or null when unknown.

kind.description: event for a line appended to a run's event stream, summary for a run's single summary line.

event.description: The event's name from the plugin's catalogue; run.summary for a summary.

run.description: The run id, unique per plugin per repository and never reused.

parent.description: <plugin>/<run id> of the run that started this one, from PLUGIN_METRICS_PARENT, or null for a run started on its own.

session.description: The Claude Code session id from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, or null.
